en.hero_desc: Trendusty Orbit is an AI-powered intelligence operations center that fuses live aviation, maritime AIS, satellite tracking, worldwide CCTV, seismic activity, wildfires, cyber threats and conflict monitoring into one interactive global picture — with an advanced OSINT toolkit and zero-lag 3D geospatial rendering.

en.feature_1_desc: Flights, ships, satellites, cameras, earthquakes, wildfires, cyber threats and conflicts — fused into a single live operating picture instead of twenty disconnected browser tabs.
en.feature_2_desc: Events appear as they happen. When a wildfire ignites, a ship deviates from its corridor, or a conflict escalates, you see it move on the map — not in tomorrow's morning briefing.
en.feature_3_desc: Self-hosted on your own computer. Role-based access, audit logging, encrypted sessions — your searches, watchlist queries, and intelligence data never leave your infrastructure.
en.feature_4_desc: Admin operations center, API keys with scopes and rate limits, high-performance rendering presets, plugin management — a full operational deck an entire security crew can rely on.
en.cap_desc: Comprehensive multi-domain intelligence tools built for physical surveillance, cyber reconnaissance, and environmental situational awareness.
en.cap_aviation_desc: 10,000+ aircraft tracked in real time — commercial airliners, general aviation, and military reconnaissance flights worldwide with 3D cockpit ride-along.
en.cap_maritime_desc: Tens of thousands of vessels via live terrestrial and satellite AIS — cargo carriers, oil tankers, fishing fleets, passenger liners, and naval deployments.
en.cap_orbital_desc: 2,000+ satellites, space stations, and rocket launches plotted live with altitude telemetry, orbit propagation, and ground pass prediction schedules.
en.cap_cctv_desc: Worldwide public camera feeds plus the ability to mount your own external RTSP and HLS video streams directly onto real-world GPS coordinates.
en.cap_osint_desc: DNS mapping, WHOIS lookups, SSL certificates, port scanners, subdomains, and threat telemetry investigation directly inside the browser console.
en.cap_breach_desc: Correlate compromised credentials and infrastructure breaches against global target sets with full cryptographic audit logging and export capabilities.

en.how_desc: Three simple stages transform noisy global radio telemetry and public sensor APIs into unified operational intelligence.

en.how_2_desc: Every entity is normalized and plotted onto one interactive 3D globe. Layers stack cleanly: flights over ships over active fault lines over conflict zones — filtered exactly the way you need.
en.how_3_desc: Investigate with the built-in OSINT toolkit, open instant live street camera streams, lock camera tracking onto moving targets, and export tactical intelligence packages to your team.
en.who_title: Built for watchers, analysts and response teams
en.who_desc: From corporate security operations centers to independent OSINT investigators and maritime enthusiasts.
en.who_1_desc: Monitor cyber threats, run recon on suspicious infrastructure, and watch physical-world events that intersect with your security posture.
en.who_2_desc: Verify events against independent live feeds — vessel movements, flight paths, seismic data and conflict zones, all with sources one click away.
en.who_3_desc: Track rare aircraft, follow vessels through chokepoints, and spot patterns across the busiest transport corridors on the planet.
en.who_4_desc: Cross-reference multiple sensor domains, verify ground truth, and document geolocated signals in a sovereign private environment.
